ko.title: 5명 사망, 계약 해지: 마이애미 활주로 참사 이후 아마존과 21 Air의 결별 내막

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: 보잉 767 화물기가 마이애미 국제공항 활주로를 이탈해 지상에 있던 5명이 사망한 사고가 발생한 지 9일 만에, 아마존은 해당 항공편을 운항했던 노스캐롤라이나 기반의 항공사 21 Air와의 화물 운송 파트너십을 중단했습니다.

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: 이번 조치는 연방 조사관들이 사고의 기계적 원인과 해당 항공사의 안전 기록을 모두 조사하는 가운데 이루어졌습니다.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## 활주로에서 무슨 일이 있었나

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: 아마존 에어(Amazon Air)를 대신해 21 Air 7598편으로 운항하던 해당 항공기는 9월 6일 오후 푸에르토리코 산후안에서 도착하여 30번 활주로에 착륙했으나, 활주로 끝까지 멈추지 못했습니다.

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: 이 제트기는 비행기 간 정비를 담당하는 하청업체가 운용하던 주차된 청소용 밴을 들이받았습니다.

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 차량 안이나 근처에 7명이 있었으며, 5명이 사망하고 다른 이들이 부상을 입었습니다.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: 이 충돌 사고로 화재가 발생해 공항 상공으로 짙은 연기가 치솟았고, 이로 인해 MIA 공항 운영이 일시적으로 중단되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## 조사관들이 지금까지 밝혀낸 사실

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: 미국 연방교통안전위원회(NTSB)는 원인을 단정하기에는 아직 이르다고 경고했지만, 비행 기록 장치에서 추출한 데이터는 충돌 직전의 마지막 몇 초 상황을 상세히 보여줍니다.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: NTSB의 예비 조사 결과에 따르면, 항공기는 약 158노트의 지상 속도로 착륙했는데 이는 767 기종의 일반적인 착륙 속도보다 훨씬 빠른 수준이었으며, 기록 장치에는 속도 브레이크나 역추진 장치가 작동했다는 징후가 전혀 나타나지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: 비행 데이터에 따르면 승무원들은 브레이크를 잠시 밟았다가 풀고, 복행(go-around)을 시도하는 수준으로 스로틀을 올렸으며, 몇 초 후 다시 아이들(idle) 상태로 줄이고 브레이크를 다시 밟은 것으로 나타났습니다.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: 조사관들은 승무원들이 접근 중 과도한 속도에 대해 우려를 표했으며, 착륙 당시 풍향 변화가 항공기 감속을 어렵게 만들었을 수 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: 제니퍼 호멘디 NTSB 위원장은 향후 몇 주 내에 더 자세한 예비 보고서가 나올 것으로 예상되며, 최종적인 사고 원인 규명에는 훨씬 더 오랜 시간이 걸릴 것이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## 21 Air와 거리를 두는 아마존

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: 사고 이후 아마존은 아마존 에어 로고가 부착된 보잉 767 화물기를 계약 운항하는 여러 지역 화물 항공사 중 하나인 21 Air와의 비행 운영을 일시 중단했다고 확인했습니다.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: 이번 중단 조치로 NTSB 조사가 진행되는 동안 신규 운항은 멈추게 되었지만, 양사 모두 조사가 끝난 후 관계가 재개될지 여부는 밝히지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: 호멘디 위원장은 조사관들이 비행 승무원의 행동뿐만 아니라 아마존과 21 Air 간의 더 넓은 관계, 특히 계약상 안전 책임과 감독이 어떻게 분담되었는지까지 면밀히 조사할 계획임을 시사했습니다. 이는 대형 화주들이 상품 운송을 위해 의존하는 외부 항공사를 어떻게 관리해야 할지에 대한 기준이 될 수 있는 문제입니다.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## 항공사의 안전 문화에 대한 의문

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: 이번 사고로 21 Air 자체에 대한 조사도 다시 강화되었습니다.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: 최근 며칠 사이 여러 전직 직원들이 마이애미 사고 이전부터 해당 항공사에 존재했던 안전 문제 패턴을 폭로하고 나섰으며, 여기에는 정비 지연 문제와 이의를 제기한 조종사 및 정비사들이 느꼈던 압박에 대한 주장이 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: 그중에는 내부적으로 안전 문제를 반복적으로 제기한 후 2022년에 해고당했다고 주장하며 연방 내부고발자 소송을 진행 중인 전 21 Air 직원도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: 이러한 내용은 법정에서 입증되지 않은 주장이며, 21 Air는 각 주장에 대해 공개적으로 상세한 답변을 내놓지 않았다는 점을 유념해야 합니다.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: NTSB는 해당 항공사의 운영 및 감독 이력에 대한 광범위한 검토의 일환으로 이러한 의혹들을 인지하고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: 현재 조사는 초기 단계에 머물러 있습니다.

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: NTSB의 절차는 일반적으로 사실 관계에 초점을 맞춘 예비 보고서가 먼저 나오고, 이후 사고 원인과 기여 요인에 대한 공식적인 결론을 내리기까지 훨씬 긴 검토 과정을 거칩니다.

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: 사망자 유가족, 항공 규제 당국, 그리고 아마존의 물류 네트워크 모두가 이 과정을 예의주시하고 있습니다. 이번 결과는 21 Air의 미래뿐만 아니라, 전국의 주요 화주들이 자신들이 의존하는 화물 항공사의 안전 관행을 어떻게 검증할지에 영향을 미칠 수 있기 때문입니다.

zh.title: 5人死亡，一份合同终止：亚马逊在迈阿密跑道致命空难后与21 Air断绝关系内幕

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: 在波音767货机冲出迈阿密国际机场跑道并造成地面5人死亡的九天后，亚马逊暂停了与21 Air的货运合作关系，这家总部位于北卡罗来纳州的航空公司正是该航班的运营商。

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: 此举正值联邦调查人员深入调查空难的机械原因以及该航空公司背后的安全记录之际。

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## 跑道上发生了什么

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: 这架以21 Air 7598航班名义运营、代表亚马逊航空（Amazon Air）的飞机，于9月6日下午从波多黎各圣胡安抵达，在降落至30号跑道时未能及时停下，冲出了跑道末端。

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: 喷气式飞机撞上了一辆停放的清洁货车，该货车由一家为航班间隙提供飞机服务的承包商运营。

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: 据报道，当时车内或车旁有七人；五人死亡，其他人受伤。

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: 坠机事故还引发了大火，浓烟笼罩了机场，导致迈阿密国际机场（MIA）的运营暂时中断。

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## 调查人员目前发现了什么

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）提醒称，现在确定事故原因还为时过早，但从飞机飞行记录仪中提取的数据描绘了撞击前最后几秒钟的详细情况。

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: 根据NTSB的初步调查结果，飞机着陆时的地速约为158节——远高于767飞机的典型着陆速度——且记录仪显示没有迹象表明飞机的减速板或推力反向器曾被启动。

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: 飞行数据显示，机组人员曾短暂踩下刹车，随后松开并推油门至与尝试复飞相符的功率水平，几秒钟后又拉回怠速并再次踩下刹车。

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: 调查人员表示，机组人员在进近过程中曾对过高的速度表示担忧，且着陆时风向的转变可能增加了机组人员减速的难度。

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: NTSB主席Jennifer Homendy表示，预计未来几周内将发布更完整的初步报告，而最终确定可能原因可能需要更长时间。

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## 亚马逊与21 Air保持距离

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: 事发后，亚马逊证实已暂停与21 Air的飞行运营。21 Air是几家根据合同运营印有亚马逊航空标志的波音767货机的区域货运航空公司之一。

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: 此次暂停在NTSB调查期间停止了新航班，尽管两家公司均未说明调查结束后是否会恢复合作关系。

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: Homendy指出，调查人员计划不仅要审查机组人员的行为，还要审查亚马逊与21 Air之间更广泛的关系，包括在合同下如何划分安全责任和监督工作——这个问题可能会影响大型托运人如何管理他们所依赖的外部承运商来运输货物。

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## 关于该航空公司安全文化的质疑

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: 此次坠机事故也让21 Air本身再次受到审视。

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: 最近几天，几名前员工站出来描述了他们所称的该航空公司在迈阿密空难之前就存在的安全隐患模式，包括关于延迟维护问题的指控，以及提出异议的飞行员和机械师所感受到的压力。

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: 其中包括一名前21 Air员工，他有一项正在进行的联邦举报人诉讼，指控他在多次内部提出安全担忧后于2022年被解雇。

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: 需要注意的是，这些指控尚未在法庭上得到证实，21 Air也未公开详细回应每一项指控。

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: NTSB已承认，作为其对该航空公司运营和监督历史进行更广泛审查的一部分，它已获悉这些指控。

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: 目前，调查仍处于早期阶段。

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: NTSB的流程通常包括一份侧重于事实调查结果的初步报告，随后在得出关于可能原因和促成因素的任何正式结论之前，还需要进行更长时间的审查。

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: 遇难者家属、航空监管机构和亚马逊的物流网络都将密切关注——结果不仅可能影响21 Air的未来，还可能影响大型托运人如何审查他们全国范围内所依赖的货运航空公司的安全实践。

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: अमेज़न एयर की ओर से 21 एयर फ़्लाइट 7598 के रूप में संचालित होने वाला विमान, 6 सितंबर की दोपहर को सैन जुआन, प्यूर्टो रिको से आ रहा था, जब उसने रनवे 30 पर लैंड किया और पक्का हिस्सा खत्म होने से पहले रुकने में असफल रहा।

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: जेट ने उड़ानों के बीच विमानों की सर्विसिंग करने वाले एक ठेकेदार द्वारा संचालित पार्क की गई सफाई वैन को टक्कर मार दी।

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: खबरों के मुताबिक वाहन में या उसके पास सात लोग थे; पांच मारे गए और अन्य घायल हो गए।

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: दुर्घटना के कारण एक आग भी लग गई जिससे एयरपोर्ट के ऊपर धुएं का घना गुबार छा गया, जिसके चलते MIA पर संचालन को अस्थायी रूप से रोकना पड़ा।

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## What investigators have found so far

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: नेशनल ट्रांसपोर्टेशन सेफ्टी बोर्ड ने चेतावनी दी है कि कोई कारण बताना अभी बहुत जल्दी होगा, लेकिन विमान के फ़्लाइट रिकॉर्डर से निकाले गए डेटा से प्रभाव से ठीक पहले के अंतिम सेकंड की एक विस्तृत तस्वीर सामने आती है।

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: NTSB के शुरुआती निष्कर्षों के अनुसार, विमान ने लगभग 158 नॉट्स की ग्राउंडस्पीड पर लैंड किया - जो 767 के लिए सामान्य लैंडिंग गति से काफी अधिक है - और रिकॉर्डर दिखाते हैं कि विमान के स्पीड ब्रेक या थ्रस्ट रिवर्सर कभी भी तैनात किए गए थे, इसका कोई संकेत नहीं मिलता है।

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: फ़्लाइट डेटा यह भी दिखाता है कि क्रू ने थोड़े समय के लिए ब्रेक लगाए, फिर उन्हें छोड़ दिया और थ्रॉटल को वापस आइडल पर खींचने और सेकंड बाद फिर से ब्रेक लगाने से पहले, गो-अराउंड के प्रयास के अनुरूप पावर स्तरों तक थ्रॉटल को ऊपर धकेल दिया।

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ताओं ने कहा है कि क्रू ने एप्रोच के दौरान अत्यधिक गति के बारे में चिंता व्यक्त की थी, और लैंडिंग के समय के आसपास हवा की दिशा में बदलाव ने विमान को धीमा करने की क्रू की क्षमता को जटिल बना दिया हो सकता है।

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: NTSB की अध्यक्ष जेनिफर होमेंडी ने कहा कि आने वाले हफ्तों में एक पूर्ण प्रारंभिक रिपोर्ट की उम्मीद है, जिसमें संभावित कारण का अंतिम निर्धारण होने में काफी अधिक समय लगने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: इसके बाद, अमेज़न ने पुष्टि की है कि उसने अनुबंध के तहत अमेज़न एयर लोगो के साथ ब्रांडेड बोइंग 767 फ़्रीज़र उड़ाने वाले कई क्षेत्रीय कार्गो वाहकों में से एक, 21 एयर के साथ उड़ान संचालन को रोक दिया है।

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: NTSB की जांच जारी रहने तक निलंबन नई उड़ानों को रोकता है, हालांकि दोनों कंपनियों में से किसी ने यह नहीं कहा है कि जांच समाप्त होने के बाद रिश्ता फिर से शुरू होगा या नहीं।

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: होमेंडी ने संकेत दिया है कि जांचकर्ताओं की योजना न केवल फ़्लाइट क्रू के कार्यों की बल्कि अमेज़न और 21 एयर के बीच व्यापक संबंध की भी जांच करने की है, जिसमें यह भी शामिल है कि उनके अनुबंध के तहत सुरक्षा जिम्मेदारियों और निगरानी को कैसे विभाजित किया गया था - एक ऐसा सवाल जो यह आकार दे सकता है कि बड़े शिपर्स उन बाहरी वाहकों का प्रबंधन कैसे करते हैं जिन पर वे सामान ले जाने के लिए निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: दुर्घटना ने 21 एयर की अपनी सुरक्षा संस्कृति की जांच को भी नए सिरे से शुरू कर दिया है।

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: कई पूर्व कर्मचारी हाल के दिनों में सामने आए हैं जो वाहक में सुरक्षा चिंताओं के एक पैटर्न के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं जो मियामी दुर्घटना से पहले का है, जिसमें विलंबित रखरखाव के मुद्दों के आरोप और आपत्ति जताने वाले पायलटों और मैकेनिक्स द्वारा महसूस किया गया दबाव शामिल है।

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: उनमें से एक पूर्व 21 एयर कर्मचारी भी है जिसका एक सक्रिय संघीय व्हिसलब्लोअर मुकदमा है जिसमें आरोप लगाया गया है कि आंतरिक रूप से बार-बार सुरक्षा चिंताओं को उठाने के बाद उसे 2022 में निकाल दिया गया था।

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: यह ध्यान रखना महत्वपूर्ण है कि ये ऐसे आरोप हैं जो अदालत में साबित नहीं हुए हैं, और 21 एयर ने प्रत्येक दावे के जवाब का सार्वजनिक रूप से विवरण नहीं दिया है।

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: NTSB ने स्वीकार किया है कि वह वाहक के संचालन और निगरानी के इतिहास की अपनी व्यापक समीक्षा के हिस्से के रूप में इन आरोपों से अवगत है।

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## What comes next

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, जांच शुरुआती चरणों में बनी हुई है।

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: NTSB की प्रक्रिया में आम तौर पर तथ्यात्मक निष्कर्षों पर केंद्रित एक प्रारंभिक रिपोर्ट शामिल होती है, जिसके बाद संभावित कारण और योगदान कारकों पर किसी भी औपचारिक निष्कर्ष से पहले बहुत लंबी समीक्षा होती है।

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: मारे गए लोगों के परिवार, उड्डयन नियामकों और अमेज़न के लॉजिस्टिक्स नेटवर्क सभी बारीकी से देख रहे होंगे - परिणाम न केवल 21 एयर के भविष्य को प्रभावित कर सकता है बल्कि यह भी प्रभावित कर सकता है कि प्रमुख शिपर्स देश भर में जिन कार्गो वाहकों पर निर्भर हैं, उनकी सुरक्षा प्रथाओं की जांच कैसे करते हैं।

es.title: 5 muertos, un contrato rescindido: Dentro de la ruptura de Amazon con 21 Air tras el mortal accidente en la pista de Miami

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: Nueve días después de que un avión de carga Boeing 767 se saliera de la pista en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Miami y matara a cinco personas en tierra, Amazon ha suspendido su asociación de carga con 21 Air, la aerolínea con sede en Carolina del Norte que operaba el vuelo.

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: La medida se produce mientras los investigadores federales profundizan tanto en la mecánica del accidente como en el historial de seguridad de la aerolínea responsable.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## Qué sucedió en la pista

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: La aeronave, que operaba como el vuelo 7598 de 21 Air en nombre de Amazon Air, llegaba desde San Juan, Puerto Rico, en la tarde del 6 de septiembre cuando aterrizó en la Pista 30 y no logró detenerse antes de quedarse sin pavimento.

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: El avión golpeó una furgoneta de limpieza estacionada, operada por un contratista que presta servicios a las aeronaves entre vuelos.

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: Según se informa, siete personas estaban dentro o cerca del vehículo; cinco murieron y otras resultaron heridas.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: El accidente también provocó un incendio que envió una densa columna de humo sobre el aeropuerto, lo que provocó una interrupción temporal de las operaciones en MIA.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## Qué han encontrado los investigadores hasta ahora

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: La Junta Nacional de Seguridad en el Transporte (NTSB) ha advertido que es demasiado pronto para determinar una causa, pero los datos extraídos de las grabadoras de vuelo del avión ofrecen una imagen detallada de los segundos finales antes del impacto.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: Según los hallazgos preliminares de la NTSB, la aeronave aterrizó a una velocidad terrestre de aproximadamente 158 nudos —muy por encima de la velocidad de aterrizaje típica de un 767— y las grabadoras no muestran indicios de que los frenos de velocidad o los inversores de empuje del avión se hayan desplegado en algún momento.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: Los datos de vuelo también muestran que la tripulación aplicó brevemente los frenos, luego los soltó y aumentó el acelerador a niveles de potencia consistentes con un intento de frustrar el aterrizaje (go-around), antes de volver a ralentí y volver a aplicar los frenos segundos después.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: Los investigadores han dicho que la tripulación expresó preocupación por la velocidad excesiva durante la aproximación, y que un cambio en la dirección del viento alrededor del momento del aterrizaje pudo haber complicado la capacidad de la tripulación para reducir la velocidad de la aeronave.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: La presidenta de la NTSB, Jennifer Homendy, dijo que se espera un informe preliminar más completo en las próximas semanas, y que una determinación final de la causa probable probablemente tomará mucho más tiempo.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## Amazon se distancia de 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: Tras el suceso, Amazon confirmó que ha pausado las operaciones de vuelo con 21 Air, una de las varias aerolíneas de carga regionales que vuelan cargueros Boeing 767 con la marca Amazon Air bajo contrato.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: La suspensión detiene los nuevos vuelos mientras continúa la investigación de la NTSB, aunque ninguna de las empresas ha dicho si la relación se reanudará una vez que concluya la investigación.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: Homendy ha indicado que los investigadores planean examinar no solo las acciones de la tripulación de vuelo, sino también la relación más amplia entre Amazon y 21 Air, incluida la forma en que se dividieron las responsabilidades de seguridad y la supervisión bajo su contrato, una cuestión que podría determinar cómo los grandes transportistas gestionan a los proveedores externos de los que dependen para mover mercancías.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## Preguntas sobre la cultura de seguridad de la aerolínea

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: El accidente también ha renovado el escrutinio sobre la propia 21 Air.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: Varios ex empleados se han presentado en los últimos días describiendo lo que caracterizan como un patrón de preocupaciones de seguridad en la aerolínea que es anterior al accidente de Miami, incluidas denuncias de problemas de mantenimiento diferido y presión sentida por pilotos y mecánicos que plantearon objeciones.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: Entre ellos se encuentra un ex empleado de 21 Air que tiene una demanda federal activa de denuncia de irregularidades (whistleblower), alegando que fue despedido en 2022 después de plantear repetidamente preocupaciones de seguridad internamente.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: Es importante señalar que estas son acusaciones que no han sido probadas en los tribunales, y 21 Air no ha detallado públicamente una respuesta a cada reclamo.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: La NTSB ha reconocido que está al tanto de las acusaciones como parte de su revisión más amplia de las operaciones y el historial de supervisión de la aerolínea.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la investigación permanece en sus primeras etapas.

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: El proceso de la NTSB generalmente incluye un informe preliminar centrado en los hallazgos fácticos, seguido de una revisión mucho más larga antes de cualquier conclusión formal sobre la causa probable y los factores contribuyentes.

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: Las familias de los fallecidos, los reguladores de aviación y la red logística de Amazon estarán observando de cerca; el resultado podría influir no solo en el futuro de 21 Air, sino también en cómo los principales transportistas evalúan las prácticas de seguridad de las aerolíneas de carga de las que dependen en todo el país.

segments.tr: تشير التقارير إلى أن سبعة أشخاص كانوا داخل السيارة أو بالقرب منها؛ قُتل خمسة وأصيب آخرون.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: أدى الحادث أيضًا إلى اندلاع حريق أرسل سحابة كثيفة من الدخان فوق المطار، مما أدى إلى وقف مؤقت للعمليات في مطار ميامي.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## ما وجده المحققون حتى الآن

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: حذر المجلس الوطني لسلامة النقل من أنه من السابق لأوانه تحديد السبب، لكن البيانات المستمدة من مسجلات طيران الطائرة ترسم صورة مفصلة للثواني الأخيرة قبل الاصطدام.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: وفقًا للنتائج الأولية للمجلس، هبطت الطائرة بسرعة أرضية تبلغ حوالي 158 عقدة - وهي أعلى بكثير من سرعة الهبوط النموذجية لطائرة 767 - وتظهر المسجلات عدم وجود أي مؤشر على نشر مكابح السرعة أو عواكس الدفع للطائرة على الإطلاق.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: تظهر بيانات الرحلة أيضًا أن الطاقم استخدم المكابح لفترة وجيزة، ثم أطلقها ودفع دوافع السرعة إلى مستويات تتوافق مع محاولة الإقلاع، قبل التراجع إلى وضع الخمول وإعادة استخدام المكابح بعد ثوانٍ.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: قال المحققون إن الطاقم أعرب عن قلقه بشأن السرعة المفرطة أثناء الاقتراب، وأن التحول في اتجاه الرياح وقت الهبوط ربما يكون قد عقّد قدرة الطاقم على إبطاء الطائرة.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: قالت جينيفر هوميندي، رئيسة المجلس الوطني لسلامة النقل، إنه من المتوقع صدور تقرير أولي أكثر شمولاً في الأسابيع المقبلة، مع احتمال استغراق التحديد النهائي للسبب المحتمل وقتًا أطول.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## أمازون تتراجع عن شركة 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: في أعقاب ذلك، أكدت أمازون أنها أوقفت عمليات الطيران مع شركة 21 Air، وهي واحدة من عدة شركات شحن إقليمية تطير بطائرات شحن بوينغ 767 تحمل شعار أمازون إير بموجب عقد.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: يوقف التعليق الرحلات الجديدة بينما تستمر تحقيقات المجلس الوطني لسلامة النقل، على الرغم من أن أيًا من الشركتين لم تذكر ما إذا كانت العلاقة ستستأنف بمجرد انتهاء التحقيق.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: أشارت هوميندي إلى أن المحققين يخططون للتدقيق ليس فقط في أجراءات طاقم الطائرة ولكن في العلاقة الأوسع بين أمازون وشركة 21 Air، بما في ذلك كيف تم تقسيم مسؤوليات السلامة والإشراف بموجب عقدها - وهو السؤال الذي يمكن أن يحدد كيفية إدارة الشحنات الكبيرة للناقلات الخارجية التي تعتمد عليها لنقل البضائع.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## أسئلة حول ثقافة السلامة للناقلة

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: أدى الحادث أيضًا إلى تجديد التدقيق في شركة 21 Air نفسها.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: تقدم العديد من الموظفين السابقين في الأيام الأخيرة لوصف ما يصفونه بأنه نمط من مخاوف السلامة في الناقلة يسبق حادث ميامي، بما في ذلك مزاعم عن مشاكل الصيانة المؤجلة والضغط الذي شعره الطيارون والميكانيكيون الذين أثاروا الاعتراضات.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: من بين هؤلاء موظف سابق في شركة 21 Air لديه دعوى قضائية نشطة لمبلغي المخالفات الفيدرالية يدعي فيها أنه تم طرده في عام 2022 بعد إثارة مخاوف تتعلق بالسلامة مرارًا وتكرارًا داخليًا.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: من المهم ملاحظة أن هذه مزاعم لم يتم إثباتها في المحكمة، ولم تفصل شركة 21 Air علنًا ردًا على كل ادعاء.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: أقر المجلس الوطني لسلامة النقل بأنه على علم بالمزاعم كجزء من مراجعته الأوسع لعمليات الناقلة وتاريخ الإشراف.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## ماذا يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يظل التحقيق في مراحله المبكرة.

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: تتضمن عملية المجلس عادةً تقريرًا أوليًا يركز على النتائج الواقعية، يليه مراجعة أطول بكثير قبل أي استنتاج رسمي بشأن السبب المحتمل والعوامل المساهمة.

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: ستراقب عائلات القتلى ومنظمو الطيران وشبكة الخدمات اللوجستية التابعة لأمازون عن كثب - فقد تؤثر النتيجة ليس فقط على مستقبل شركة 21 Air ولكن على كيفية تدقيق الشاحنين الرئيسيين في ممارسات السلامة لشركات الشحن التي يعتمدون عليها في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

fr.title: 5 morts, un contrat résilié : Dans les coulisses de la rupture d'Amazon avec 21 Air après le crash mortel sur la piste de Miami

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: Neuf jours après qu'un avion-cargo Boeing 767 a dépassé une piste à l'aéroport international de Miami, tuant cinq personnes au sol, Amazon a suspendu son partenariat de fret avec 21 Air, le transporteur basé en Caroline du Nord qui exploitait le vol.

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: Cette décision intervient alors que les enquêteurs fédéraux se penchent à la fois sur la mécanique de l'accident et sur le bilan de sécurité de la compagnie aérienne concernée.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## Que s'est-il passé sur la piste

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: L'appareil, qui opérait sous le numéro de vol 21 Air 7598 pour le compte d'Amazon Air, arrivait de San Juan, à Porto Rico, l'après-midi du 6 septembre lorsqu'il a touché le sol sur la piste 30 et n'a pas réussi à s'arrêter avant la fin de la piste.

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: Le biréacteur a percuté une camionnette de nettoyage garée, exploitée par un sous-traitant qui assure l'entretien des avions entre les vols.

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: Sept personnes se trouvaient apparemment à bord ou à proximité du véhicule ; cinq ont été tuées et d'autres blessées.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: Le crash a également déclenché un incendie qui a dégagé un épais panache de fumée au-dessus de l'aéroport, entraînant une interruption temporaire des opérations à MIA.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## Ce que les enquêteurs ont découvert jusqu'à présent

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: Le Conseil national de la sécurité des transports (NTSB) a averti qu'il était trop tôt pour attribuer une cause, mais les données extraites des enregistreurs de vol de l'appareil dressent un tableau détaillé des dernières secondes avant l'impact.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: Selon les conclusions préliminaires du NTSB, l'avion a touché le sol à une vitesse sol d'environ 158 nœuds — bien au-dessus de la vitesse d'atterrissage typique d'un 767 — et les enregistreurs n'indiquent pas que les aérodynamiques ou les inverseurs de poussée de l'avion ont été déployés.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: Les données de vol montrent également que l'équipage a brièvement appliqué les freins, puis les a relâchés et a poussé les manettes des gaz à des niveaux de puissance correspondant à une tentative de remise des gaz, avant de revenir au ralenti et de réappliquer les freins quelques secondes plus tard.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs ont indiqué que l'équipage avait exprimé des inquiétudes concernant une vitesse excessive lors de l'approche, et qu'un changement de direction du vent au moment de l'atterrissage avait pu compliquer la capacité de l'équipage à ralentir l'appareil.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: La présidente du NTSB, Jennifer Homendy, a déclaré qu'un rapport préliminaire plus complet était attendu dans les semaines à venir, la détermination finale de la cause probable devant probablement prendre beaucoup plus de temps.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## Amazon prend ses distances avec 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: À la suite de cet événement, Amazon a confirmé avoir suspendu ses opérations aériennes avec 21 Air, l'un des nombreux transporteurs de fret régionaux qui exploitent sous contrat des Boeing 767 cargo arborant le logo Amazon Air.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: La suspension interrompt les nouveaux vols pendant que l'enquête du NTSB se poursuit, bien qu'aucune des deux entreprises n'ait précisé si leur relation reprendrait une fois l'enquête terminée.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: Homendy a indiqué que les enquêteurs prévoyaient d'examiner de près non seulement les actions de l'équipage de conduite, mais aussi la relation plus large entre Amazon et 21 Air, y compris la manière dont les responsabilités en matière de sécurité et la surveillance étaient réparties dans le cadre de leur contrat — une question qui pourrait influencer la façon dont les grands expéditeurs gèrent les transporteurs externes dont ils dépendent pour acheminer leurs marchandises.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## Questions sur la culture de sécurité du transporteur

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: Le crash a également relancé l'examen minutieux de 21 Air elle-même.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: Plusieurs anciens employés se sont manifestés ces derniers jours pour décrire ce qu'ils qualifient de schéma récurrent de problèmes de sécurité chez le transporteur, antérieur au crash de Miami, notamment des allégations de maintenance différée et de pressions ressenties par les pilotes et les mécaniciens qui formulaient des objections.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: Parmi eux figure un ancien employé de 21 Air qui a intenté une action en justice fédérale active en tant que lanceur d'alerte, affirmant avoir été licencié en 2022 après avoir soulevé à plusieurs reprises des questions de sécurité en interne.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: Il convient de noter qu'il s'agit d'allégations qui n'ont pas été prouvées devant les tribunaux, et 21 Air n'a pas détaillé publiquement de réponse à chaque affirmation.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: Le NTSB a reconnu être au courant de ces allégations dans le cadre de son examen plus large des opérations et de l'historique de surveillance du transporteur.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la prochaine étape

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, l'enquête n'en est qu'à ses débuts.

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: Le processus du NTSB comprend généralement un rapport préliminaire axé sur les éléments factuels, suivi d'un examen beaucoup plus long avant toute conclusion formelle sur la cause probable et les facteurs contributifs.

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: Les familles des victimes, les régulateurs de l'aviation et le réseau logistique d'Amazon suivront tous la situation de près — le résultat pourrait influencer non seulement l'avenir de 21 Air, mais aussi la manière dont les grands expéditeurs évaluent les pratiques de sécurité des transporteurs de fret sur lesquels ils s'appuient à l'échelle nationale.

pt.title: 5 Mortos, Um Contrato Rompido: Por Dentro da Ruptura da Amazon com a 21 Air Após o Acidente Fatal na Pista de Miami

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: Nove dias após um jato de carga Boeing 767 ultrapassar uma pista no Aeroporto Internacional de Miami e matar cinco pessoas no solo, a Amazon suspendeu sua parceria de carga com a 21 Air, a companhia aérea sediada na Carolina do Norte que operava o voo.

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: A decisão ocorre no momento em que investigadores federais examinam tanto a mecânica do acidente quanto o histórico de segurança da companhia aérea por trás dele.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## O que aconteceu na pista

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: A aeronave, operando como o Voo 7598 da 21 Air em nome da Amazon Air, estava chegando de San Juan, Porto Rico, na tarde de 6 de setembro, quando pousou na Pista 30 e não conseguiu parar antes de o pavimento acabar.

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: O jato atingiu uma van de limpeza estacionada operada por um contratado que atende aeronaves entre os voos.

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: Sete pessoas estariam dentro ou perto do veículo; cinco morreram e outras ficaram feridas.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: O acidente também provocou um incêndio que enviou uma densa pluma de fumaça sobre o aeroporto, levando a uma paralisação temporária das operações em MIA.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## O que os investigadores descobriram até agora

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: O Conselho Nacional de Segurança nos Transportes (NTSB) alertou que é muito cedo para apontar uma causa, mas os dados extraídos dos gravadores de voo do avião pintam um quadro detalhado dos segundos finais antes do impacto.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: De acordo com as descobertas preliminares do NTSB, a aeronave pousou a uma velocidade em solo de aproximadamente 158 nós — bem acima de uma velocidade típica de pouso para um 767 — e os gravadores não mostram indicação de que os freios aerodinâmicos ou reversores de empuxo do avião tenham sido acionados.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: Os dados de voo também mostram que a tripulação acionou brevemente os freios, depois os liberou e empurrou as manetes de potência para níveis consistentes com uma tentativa de arremetida, antes de puxar de volta para a marcha lenta e reaplicar os freios segundos depois.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: Os investigadores disseram que a tripulação expressou preocupação com a velocidade excessiva durante a aproximação e que uma mudança na direção do vento por volta do momento do pouso pode ter complicado a capacidade da tripulação de desacelerar a aeronave.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: A presidente do NTSB, Jennifer Homendy, disse que um relatório preliminar mais completo é esperado nas próximas semanas, com uma determinação final da causa provável provavelmente levando muito mais tempo.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## A Amazon se afasta da 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: No rescaldo, a Amazon confirmou que pausou as operações de voo com a 21 Air, uma das várias transportadoras de carga regionais que voam com freighters Boeing 767 com a marca Amazon Air sob contrato.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: A suspensão interrompe novos voos enquanto a investigação do NTSB continua, embora nenhuma das empresas tenha dito se o relacionamento será retomado assim que o inquérito for concluído.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: Homendy indicou que os investigadores planejam examinar não apenas as ações da tripulação de voo, mas a relação mais ampla entre a Amazon e a 21 Air, incluindo como as responsabilidades de segurança e a supervisão foram divididas sob seu contrato — uma questão que pode moldar como os grandes remetentes gerenciam as transportadoras externas de que dependem para mover mercadorias.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## Perguntas sobre a cultura de segurança da transportadora

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: O acidente também renovou o escrutínio sobre a própria 21 Air.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: Vários ex-funcionários se apresentaram nos últimos dias descrevendo o que caracterizam como um padrão de preocupações de segurança na transportadora que antecede o acidente de Miami, incluindo alegações de problemas de manutenção adiada e pressão sentida por pilotos e mecânicos que levantaram objeções.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: Entre eles está um ex-funcionário da 21 Air que tem uma ação judicial federal ativa de denunciante (whistleblower) alegando que foi demitido em 2022 após levantar repetidamente preocupações de segurança internamente.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: É importante notar que estas são alegações que não foram comprovadas em tribunal, e a 21 Air não detalhou publicamente uma resposta a cada afirmação.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: O NTSB reconheceu que está ciente das alegações como parte de sua revisão mais ampla das operações da transportadora e do histórico de supervisão.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## O que vem a seguir

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.

in.title: 5 Tewas, Satu Kontrak Diputus: Di Balik Keputusan Amazon Mengakhiri Kerja Sama dengan 21 Air Setelah Kecelakaan Mematikan di Landasan Pacu Miami

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: Sembilan hari setelah pesawat kargo Boeing 767 melampaui landasan pacu di Bandara Internasional Miami dan menewaskan lima orang di darat, Amazon telah menangguhkan kemitraan kargonya dengan 21 Air, maskapai penerbangan yang berbasis di North Carolina yang mengoperasikan penerbangan tersebut.

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.
segments.tr: Langkah ini diambil saat penyelidik federal mendalami mekanisme kecelakaan dan catatan keselamatan maskapai di baliknya.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## Apa yang terjadi di landasan pacu

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: Pesawat tersebut, yang beroperasi sebagai 21 Air Flight 7598 atas nama Amazon Air, tiba dari San Juan, Puerto Rico, pada sore hari tanggal 6 September ketika mendarat di Runway 30 dan gagal berhenti sebelum kehabisan landasan.

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: Pesawat itu menabrak mobil van pembersih yang diparkir dan dioperasikan oleh kontraktor yang melayani pesawat di antara penerbangan.

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: Tujuh orang dilaporkan berada di dalam atau di dekat kendaraan tersebut; lima orang tewas dan lainnya terluka.

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: Kecelakaan itu juga memicu kebakaran yang mengirimkan gumpalan asap tebal ke atas bandara, yang menyebabkan penghentian sementara operasional di MIA.

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## Apa yang telah ditemukan oleh penyelidik sejauh ini

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: Dewan Keselamatan Transportasi Nasional (NTSB) telah memperingatkan bahwa terlalu dini untuk menentukan penyebabnya, tetapi data yang diambil dari perekam penerbangan pesawat memberikan gambaran rinci tentang detik-detik terakhir sebelum benturan.

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: Menurut temuan awal NTSB, pesawat mendarat dengan kecepatan darat sekitar 158 knot — jauh di atas kecepatan pendaratan tipikal untuk 767 — dan perekam tidak menunjukkan indikasi bahwa rem kecepatan atau pembalik dorong pesawat pernah digunakan.

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: Data penerbangan juga menunjukkan kru sempat mengerem, lalu melepaskannya dan mendorong throttle ke tingkat tenaga yang konsisten dengan upaya go-around, sebelum menariknya kembali ke posisi idle dan mengerem kembali beberapa detik kemudian.

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: Penyelidik mengatakan kru menyatakan kekhawatiran tentang kecepatan yang berlebihan selama pendekatan, dan bahwa perubahan arah angin di sekitar waktu pendaratan mungkin telah mempersulit kemampuan kru untuk memperlambat pesawat.

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: Ketua NTSB Jennifer Homendy mengatakan laporan awal yang lebih lengkap diharapkan dalam beberapa minggu mendatang, dengan penentuan akhir penyebab kemungkinan akan memakan waktu lebih lama.

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## Amazon menarik diri dari 21 Air

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: Setelah kejadian tersebut, Amazon mengonfirmasi telah menghentikan operasi penerbangan dengan 21 Air, salah satu dari beberapa maskapai kargo regional yang menerbangkan pesawat kargo Boeing 767 dengan logo Amazon Air di bawah kontrak.

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: Penangguhan tersebut menghentikan penerbangan baru sementara penyelidikan NTSB berlanjut, meskipun tidak satu pun dari perusahaan tersebut mengatakan apakah hubungan akan berlanjut setelah penyelidikan selesai.

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: Homendy telah mengindikasikan bahwa penyelidik berencana untuk meneliti tidak hanya tindakan kru penerbangan tetapi juga hubungan yang lebih luas antara Amazon dan 21 Air, termasuk bagaimana tanggung jawab keselamatan dan pengawasan dibagi di bawah kontrak mereka — sebuah pertanyaan yang dapat membentuk bagaimana pengirim besar mengelola maskapai luar yang mereka andalkan untuk memindahkan barang.

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan tentang budaya keselamatan maskapai

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: Kecelakaan itu juga memperbarui pengawasan terhadap 21 Air itu sendiri.

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: Beberapa mantan karyawan telah muncul dalam beberapa hari terakhir menggambarkan apa yang mereka sebut sebagai pola masalah keselamatan di maskapai tersebut yang sudah ada sebelum kecelakaan Miami, termasuk tuduhan masalah pemeliharaan yang ditunda dan tekanan yang dirasakan oleh pilot dan mekanik yang mengajukan keberatan.

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: Di antara mereka adalah mantan karyawan 21 Air yang memiliki gugatan whistleblower federal aktif yang menuduh dia dipecat pada tahun 2022 setelah berulang kali mengajukan masalah keselamatan secara internal.

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: Penting untuk dicatat bahwa ini adalah tuduhan yang belum terbukti di pengadilan, dan 21 Air belum secara terbuka merinci tanggapan terhadap setiap klaim.

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: NTSB telah mengakui bahwa mereka mengetahui tuduhan tersebut sebagai bagian dari tinjauan yang lebih luas terhadap operasi dan sejarah pengawasan maskapai.

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## Apa langkah selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, penyelidikan tetap dalam tahap awal.

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: Proses NTSB biasanya mencakup laporan awal yang berfokus pada temuan faktual, diikuti oleh tinjauan yang jauh lebih lama sebelum kesimpulan formal apa pun mengenai penyebab kemungkinan dan faktor-faktor yang berkontribusi.

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
segments.tr: Keluarga dari mereka yang tewas, regulator penerbangan, dan jaringan logistik Amazon semuanya akan mengawasi dengan cermat — hasilnya dapat memengaruhi tidak hanya masa depan 21 Air tetapi juga bagaimana pengirim besar memeriksa praktik keselamatan maskapai kargo yang mereka andalkan secara nasional.

ja.title: 死者5人、契約解除：マイアミの致命的な滑走路逸脱事故を受け、アマゾンが21エアーとの提携を断つ内幕

segments.src: Nine days after a Boeing 767 cargo jet overran a runway at Miami International Airport and killed five people on the ground, Amazon has suspended its cargo partnership with 21 Air, the North Carolina-based carrier that operated the flight.
segments.tr: マイアミ国際空港でボーイング767貨物ジェット機が滑走路をオーバーランし、地上の5人が死亡した事故から9日後、アマゾンは運航会社であるノースカロライナ州の航空会社21エアーとの貨物提携を一時停止した。

segments.src: The move comes as federal investigators dig into both the mechanics of the crash and the safety record of the airline behind it.

segments.src: ## What happened on the runway
segments.tr: ## 滑走路での出来事

segments.src: The aircraft, operating as 21 Air Flight 7598 on behalf of Amazon Air, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on the afternoon of September 6 when it touched down on Runway 30 and failed to stop before running out of pavement.
segments.tr: アマゾン・エアーに代わって21エアーの7598便として運航されていた同機は、プエルトリコのサンジュアンから到着し、9月6日の午後に滑走路30に着陸したが、舗装路の端に達する前に停止できなかった。

segments.src: The jet struck a parked cleaning van operated by a contractor that services aircraft between flights.
segments.tr: ジェット機は、フライトの合間に航空機のサービスを行う請負業者が所有していた駐車中の清掃用バンに衝突した。

segments.src: Seven people were reportedly in or near the vehicle; five were killed and others injured.
segments.tr: 車両内またはその周辺には7人がいたと報じられており、5人が死亡し、他の人が負傷した。

segments.src: The crash also sparked a fire that sent a heavy plume of smoke over the airport, prompting a temporary halt to operations at MIA.
segments.tr: この墜落事故はまた、空港上空に濃い煙の立ちこめる火災を引き起こし、マイアミ国際空港での運航の一時停止を余儀なくさせた。

segments.src: ## What investigators have found so far
segments.tr: ## これまでに捜査官が判明させたこと

segments.src: The National Transportation Safety Board has cautioned that it is too early to assign a cause, but data pulled from the plane's flight recorders paints a detailed picture of the final seconds before impact.
segments.tr: 国家運輸安全委員会（NTSB）は、原因を特定するには時期尚早であると警告しているが、飛行機のフライトレコーダーから抽出されたデータは、衝突前の最後の数秒間の詳細な状況を描き出している。

segments.src: According to the NTSB's preliminary findings, the aircraft touched down at a groundspeed of roughly 158 knots — well above a typical landing speed for a 767 — and the recorders show no indication that the plane's speed brakes or thrust reversers were ever deployed.
segments.tr: NTSBの初期調査結果によると、同機は767の一般的な着陸速度を大幅に上回る時速約158ノットの対地速度で着陸し、レコーダーには機体のスピードブレーキやスラストリバーサー（推力逆噴射装置）が作動した形跡は一切示されていない。

segments.src: Flight data also shows the crew briefly applied the brakes, then released them and pushed the throttles up to power levels consistent with an attempted go-around, before pulling back to idle and reapplying the brakes seconds later.
segments.tr: フライトデータによると、乗員は一旦ブレーキを軽く踏んだ後、それを解除し、ゴーアラウンド（やり直し）の試みに一致するパワーレベルまでスロットルを押し上げ、数秒後にアイドル状態に戻して再びブレーキを踏んだことが示されている。

segments.src: Investigators have said the crew expressed concern about excessive speed during the approach, and that a shift in wind direction around the time of landing may have complicated the crew's ability to slow the aircraft.
segments.tr: 捜査官らは、乗員がアプローチ中の過度な速度について懸念を表明していたこと、そして着陸時の風向きの変化が機体を減速させる乗員の能力を複雑にした可能性があると述べている。

segments.src: NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said a fuller preliminary report is expected in the coming weeks, with a final determination of probable cause likely taking much longer.
segments.tr: NTSBのジェニファー・ホメンディ委員長は、今後数週間のうちに詳細な予備報告書がまとまる見込みであり、事故原因の最終的な特定にはさらに長い時間がかかる可能性が高いと述べた。

segments.src: ## Amazon steps back from 21 Air
segments.tr: ## アマゾン、21エアーから距離を置く

segments.src: In the aftermath, Amazon confirmed it has paused flight operations with 21 Air, one of several regional cargo carriers that fly Boeing 767 freighters branded with the Amazon Air logo under contract.
segments.tr: その余波の中で、アマゾンは、契約に基づいてアマゾン・エアーのロゴが描かれたボーイング767貨物機を運行する複数の地域貨物運送会社の1つである21エアーとの飛行運航を一時停止したことを認めた。

segments.src: The suspension halts new flights while the NTSB investigation continues, though neither company has said whether the relationship will resume once the inquiry concludes.
segments.tr: NTSBの調査が継続する間、この一時停止によって新規の飛行は停止されるが、調査終了後に両社の関係が再開されるかどうかについては、どちらの企業も言明していない。

segments.src: Homendy has indicated that investigators plan to scrutinize not just the flight crew's actions but the broader relationship between Amazon and 21 Air, including how safety responsibilities and oversight were divided under their contract — a question that could shape how large shippers manage the outside carriers they depend on to move goods.
segments.tr: ホメンディ氏は、捜査官らがフライトクルーの行動だけでなく、アマゾンと21エアーの間のより広範な関係、つまり契約の下で安全責任と監督がどのように分担されていたかについても精査する計画であることを示唆しており、この疑問は大規模な荷主が物品を移動するために依存する外部の運送会社をどのように管理するかを形作る可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Questions about the carrier's safety culture
segments.tr: ## 運送会社の安全文化に対する疑問

segments.src: The crash has also renewed scrutiny of 21 Air itself.
segments.tr: この墜落事故により、21エアー自体に対する監視の目も再び向けられている。

segments.src: Several former employees have come forward in recent days describing what they characterize as a pattern of safety concerns at the carrier that predates the Miami crash, including allegations of deferred maintenance issues and pressure felt by pilots and mechanics who raised objections.
segments.tr: 近年、複数の元従業員名が名乗り出ており、マイアミの墜落事故以前から同社に存在していたとする安全上の懸念のパターンを特徴づけて説明している。これには、先送りにされた保守の問題や、異議を唱えたパイロットやメカニックが感じたプレッシャーの主張が含まれている。

segments.src: Among them is a former 21 Air employee who has an active federal whistleblower lawsuit alleging he was fired in 2022 after repeatedly raising safety concerns internally.
segments.tr: その中には、社内で繰り返し安全上の懸念を提起した後、2022年に解雇されたと主張する、進行中の連邦内部告発者訴訟を抱える21エアーの元従業員も含まれている。

segments.src: It's important to note these are allegations that have not been proven in court, and 21 Air has not publicly detailed a response to each claim.
segments.tr: これらは法廷で証明されていない主張であり、21エアーは各クレームに対する公式な見解を詳細に発表していないことに留意することが重要である。

segments.src: The NTSB has acknowledged it is aware of the allegations as part of its broader review of the carrier's operations and oversight history.
segments.tr: NTSBは、同社の運航および監督履歴に関する広範な見直しの一環として、これらの申し立てを認識していることを認めている。

segments.src: ## What comes next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるのか

segments.src: For now, the investigation remains in its early stages.
segments.tr: 今のところ、調査は初期段階にとどまっている。

segments.src: The NTSB's process typically includes a preliminary report focused on factual findings, followed by a much longer review before any formal conclusion on probable cause and contributing factors.
segments.tr: NTSBのプロセスには通常、事実関係の調査結果に焦点を当てた予備報告書が含まれ、その後、原因や寄与要因に関する正式な結論を下す前に、はるかに長い審査が行われる。

segments.src: Families of those killed, aviation regulators, and Amazon's logistics network will all be watching closely — the outcome could influence not only 21 Air's future but how major shippers vet the safety practices of the cargo carriers they rely on nationwide.
